{{short description|Japanese mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=March 2020}}
{{Nihongo|'''Nagayoshi Iwahori'''|岩堀 長慶|Iwahori Nagayoshi|1926 to 29 May 2011}} was a Japanese mathematician who worked on [[algebraic group]]s over [[local field]]s who introduced [[Iwahori–Hecke algebra]]s and [[Iwahori subgroup]]s.

==Publications==
*{{Citation | last1=Iwahori | first1=N. | last2=Matsumoto | first2=H. | title=On some Bruhat decomposition and the structure of the Hecke rings of ''p''-adic Chevalley groups | url=http://www.numdam.org/item?id=PMIHES_1965__25__5_0 | mr=0185016 | year=1965 | journal=[[Publications Mathématiques de l'IHÉS]] | volume=25 | issn=1618-1913 | issue=25 | pages=5–48| doi=10.1007/BF02684396 | s2cid=4591855 }}
